# Gates

<!-- Generated from gates/registry.yaml by `make harness-docs`. Do not edit: the docs gate fails when this page drifts. -->

A gate is one check with a verdict. The changed paths select suites, and a gate runs at its cadences when one of its suites is selected (`*`: whatever changed).
A path that no suite claims selects every suite. Run one gate with `make gate ID=<gate>`.

| Cadence   | When                                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `edit`    | an agent edits a file (Claude Code hook)                        |
| `stop`    | an agent stops, or `make check-fast`                            |
| `commit`  | the git pre-commit hook, `make pre-commit`, on the staged files |
| `pr`      | before a pull request is opened                                 |
| `ci`      | GitHub Actions, on every pull request and every push to `main`  |
| `nightly` | the nightly run                                                 |

## Suites

| Suite        | Covers                                                                                                                 | Paths                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Implies |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `everything` | The harness and the repository-wide tooling; a change here checks everything                                           | `cmd/harness/**` `internal/harness/**` `cmd/surface/**` `cmd/analyzers/**` `cmd/coverage/**` `cmd/load/**` `internal/load/**` `internal/surface/**` `internal/analyzers/**` `gates/**` `bin/**` `.githooks/**` `.github/**` `Makefile` `scripts/harness.mk` `scripts/release.mk` `.golangci.yml` `.markdownlint.jsonc` `.prettierrc.json` `.gitleaks.toml` `checkmake.ini` `go.mod` `go.sum` `baselines/load/**` |         |
| `surface`    | What the model reads - tool definitions and descriptions, schemas, resources                                           | `internal/tools/*/definition.go` `internal/tools/*/models.go` `internal/tools/*/results.go` `internal/tools/schema.go` `internal/tools/union_schema.go` `internal/tools/annotations.go` `internal/tools/errors.go` `internal/resources/**` `baselines/surface/**`                                                                                                                                                | `tools` |
| `trust`      | The untrusted-data boundary, permissions and authentication                                                            | `internal/utils/parsers.go` `internal/utils/dates.go` `internal/utils/fields.go` `internal/permissions/**` `internal/auth/**` `bootstrap/allowlist.go` `bootstrap/inprocess.go` `docs/reference/permissions-examples/**`                                                                                                                                                                                         | `tools` |
| `tools`      | Tool handlers and the code they share                                                                                  | `internal/tools/**` `internal/utils/**` `internal/types/**` `internal/logging/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |         |
| `server`     | Server wiring, transports and the binary                                                                               | `bootstrap/**` `cmd/server/**` `version/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `tools` |
| `tests`      | Test helpers, fixtures and the integration stack                                                                       | `internal/testutils/**` `**/*_test.go` `docker-compose.test.yml` `docker-compose.license.yml`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |         |
| `packaging`  | The production image, the MCPB packages and the release archives                                                       | `deployment/**` `scripts/Dockerfile.mcpb` `.dockerignore`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |
| `spec`       | The spec items - what the server promises a model, each traced to what proves it                                       | `spec/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |         |
| `docs`       | Documentation and agent instructions                                                                                   | `docs/**` `*.md` `.claude/skills/**`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |         |
| `meta`       | Repository metadata no gate reads (renovate.json's security settings are held by a unit test, which every change runs) | `LICENSE` `NOTICE` `renovate.json` `.sonarcloud.properties` `.air.toml` `.env.template`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |         |
